features.title: Read-only Billy access
features.description: Read and search Billy records without creating, updating, or deleting anything.

features.title: Create and update bank payments
features.description: Create bank-payment records and update existing bank-payment records. It does not enable deleting bank payments.

features.title: Manage bank-line reconciliation
features.description: Create, update, and delete bank-line matches and bank-line subject associations used to reconcile Billy postings with imported bank lines.

features.title: Create and update daybook corrections
features.description: Create and update daybook transactions and their lines for controlled accounting corrections. It does not enable deleting daybook records.
